rationale: S41 + S53. A channel reset (Reset at Song Sequence Change / Reset at Pattern Repeat, via m_clock.realign_sprockets -> Lattice:realign_eligable_sprockets) that lands in the middle of a channel step left shuffle_updated set, so the restarted step 1 was never resolved by begin_cycle: it kept current_ppqn = division * ppqn * 4, the straight and unrounded length (m_lattice.lua:703-704). On a swung channel the restarted first step ran straight and the swing pairs were shifted until the next reset (M-TIME-014: /2 Swing 25, slot 2 step 1 lasted 48 pulses instead of 60, steps at +48/+84 instead of +60/+96). On a fractional clock the restarted step was left at 62.4 pulses (/2.6): it lasted 62 pulses instead of the 63 it lasts from Play, and a slide planned over it used the fractional length, so its CC samples differed from the first repeat's (M-SLIDE-RESET-001: 16,33,49,65,81,98,114 instead of 16,32,48,65,81,97,113, destination one pulse early). A reset exactly on a step boundary already cleared shuffle_updated (finish_cycle). The fix clears shuffle_updated at every realign, so a mid-step reset leaves the sprocket in the same state as a boundary reset and the restarted step 1 is resolved by begin_cycle exactly as from Play; onset projection (project_onset_occurrence) then begins that cycle on its copy and returns whole pulses.
oracle: README 1074 (Reset at Song Sequence Change resets all channels at the transition) and README 1078 (Reset at Pattern Repeat resets all channels back to their starting step at every start of the pattern): a restarted channel is that channel from its step 1 again, so every restarted slot must play like the first from Play. README 683: swing moves notes closer or further apart (60/36-pulse pairs at /2 Swing 25, first step long). README 964: slides smoothly transition between locks; each repeat's slide equals the first repeat's (M-SLIDE-RESET-001). Pulse arithmetic is spelled out in the cases.
collateral: M-SLIDE-RESET-001 (S53 regression) failed at baseline in both lanes (86a0e1c0 real-time: slide samples 16,33,49,...,114 after the reset vs 16,32,48,...,113 from Play; 129f94f8 controlled: restarted step 2 at pulse 158, not 159) and passes with the fix (bc0da3ff, 263415bc, repeat-c4682700).
